subject: Discovery recap & trial confirmation — Zentara Health
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@zentarahealth.com>, Dr. Priya Menon <p.menon@zentarahealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & proposed trial scope — Zentara Health

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap so we have a shared view and clear next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Pain points you highlighted:
- High false positives in triage (esp. COVID-related claims) causing manual review backlog.
- Latency spikes on current on-prem pipeline adding to clinician wait time.
- Hard to iterate on prompt/labeling across teams — lack of stable evals.

Goals for a short trial (our proposal):
1) Reduce triage FPR by 20% (measured on your de-identified 10k sample).
2) Maintain P95 latency under 350ms for 512-token inference in the trial environment.
3) Establish a prompt/eval suite and automated regression checks to prevent quality drift.

Proposed POC scope (4 weeks evaluation after setup):
- Environment: Redwood hosted test endpoint inside your VPC peering (dedicated subnet).
- Data: de-identified sample + synthetic edge cases from your team.
- Deliverables: prompt set (50 canonical prompts), evaluation harness (F1/recall/precision), dashboard access, weekly checkpoints.

Success metrics we propose to track:
- F1 (primary): target >= 0.78 on the labeled sample.
- False positive rate: -20% vs baseline.
- Latency: P95 < 350ms, P99 < 600ms.
- Throughput: baseline 10 req/s sustained.

Immediate asks from your side to start the setup:
- Confirm trial owners: technical owner + clinical reviewer (names).
- Provide S3 read-only path or one-time secure upload for the 10k de-id sample.
- Approve scoped IAM service account or create a short-lived service key for Redwood to access the bucket.
- Add seang@redwood.ai and grace.oconnor@redwood.ai to the procurement thread for contract steps.

I attached a one-page checklist (Zentara_trial_checklist.xlsx) with the access items.

Tentative timeline: setup (week 1), tuning & eval (weeks 2–5), review & decision (end of week 6). We can compress if you want a faster cadence.

Next steps: please confirm owners and whether you prefer VPC peering or secure transfer for the data. Happy to jump on a 30-min setup slot tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Zentara_trial_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@zentarahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dr. Priya Menon <p.menon@zentarahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & proposed trial scope — Zentara Health

Thanks, Grace — this captures it well. Quick answers:

- Owners: technical owner = Alex Byrne (me), clinical reviewer = Dr. Priya Menon.
- Data transfer: prefer S3 temporary credentials (we can generate a pre-signed URL) to avoid VPC setup in week 1.
- Timeline: the 6-week outline looks right; we'd like to aim for a faster decision if early metrics look promising (target decision at end of week 4).

Security: we'll need your SOC 2 Type II report and a short data handling note before we hand over the sample. Also include any default data retention windows for temp logs.

I'll loop in our procurement after we confirm the technical plan.

Alex
Alex Byrne
Senior Product Manager, Zentara Health
alex.byrne@zentarahealth.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@zentarahealth.com>, Dr. Priya Menon <p.menon@zentarahealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & proposed trial scope — Zentara Health

Appreciate the quick reply, Alex — good to have owners. Notes and adjustments below:

Access plan (short form):
- We can accept a pre-signed S3 URL for the initial 10k de-id sample. Marcus will pull and stage into a sandbox bucket in our test project.
- For evaluation, Redwood will create a short-lived service account scoped to the sandbox bucket; credentials auto-rotate after 48 hours.

Evaluation & prompts:
- Marcus will build the prompt set (50 prompts + 30 adversarial cases) and the eval harness.
- We'll run nightly regression checks and produce a quality dashboard (F1, precision/recall, FP rate).

Technical SLAs to validate during the POC:
- P95 latency target: 350ms (512 tokens)
- P99 target: 600ms
- Throughput: baseline 10 req/s; note we can ramp if you need higher.

Pilot owners and responsibilities:
- Alex Byrne (Zentara) — product decision maker, access approvals.
- Dr. Priya Menon (Zentara) — clinical review and sample labeling guidance.
- Grace O'Connor (Redwood) — overall trial lead and escalation contact.
- Sean Gallagher (Redwood) — success manager, weekly checkpoints.
- Marcus Lin (Redwood) — infra lead, data ingestion + prompt tuning.

Deliverables (end of evaluation):
- PO C charter PDF (attached), prompt set, eval report, dashboard access, and a short runbook for production handoff.

Attachments: POC_Charter_v1.pdf (outline + acceptance criteria).

If that looks good I propose a 30-min setup call Wednesday 10:00am PT to have Marcus and your engineer exchange S3 details and to get the pre-signed URL.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: POC_Charter_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Dr. Priya Menon <p.menon@zentarahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@zentarahealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & proposed trial scope — Zentara Health

Thanks, Grace / Alex — this is a good plan and the metrics look aligned with clinical goals. A couple of items from my side before we proceed:

1) Data: We will provide the de-identified set plus a small labeled subset for initial tuning (approx. 1k records). Please confirm you will not log any raw PHI and that all logs are ephemeral.
2) Security docs: please share SOC 2 Type II and the network diagram for the trial architecture. Procurement will need those to proceed with the security questionnaire.
3) Acceptance criteria: if the FP rate reduction target is met early (by week 3) can we schedule an accelerated review to move toward a pilot?

If you can share the SOC2 and diagram in the next 48 hours, we can generate the pre-signed URL and hit your proposed Wednesday setup slot.

Priya
Dr. Priya Menon
Director of Clinical Informatics, Zentara Health
